author: Yffe
content: Investigated: the router (tooling/spec-routes.toml) + both gates (spec-discipline.py, anti-pattern-gate.py) + .claude/settings.json are ALREADY git-tracked, and settings.json wires the gates to the tracked tooling/ paths -> they ship + auto-fire on a clone. .claude/hooks/*.py (work-check/session-start/etc.) are gitignored crosslink-harness infra (import crosslink_config, shell out to the crosslink CLI + .crosslink DB) — correctly NOT shipped (regenerated by crosslink init; every hook is if-[-f]-guarded so a clone degrades them to no-ops while tooling/ gates still fire). No code/gitignore change needed. Fix: the README on-ramp conflated the tooling/ gates with .claude/hooks/ — corrected it (separate the shipped tooling/ enforcement from the env-provided crosslink machinery) + added a 'Setting up a fresh clone' note (gates work immediately; run crosslink init for the issue-tracking layer).
